status: Implemented and locally validated; not committed/pushed in this change.
scope: FE07 pickup/delivery verification and durable mission progress for the current Webots adapter.

baSources.requirement: FE07: pickup/delivery confirmation, QR/manual verification and status tracking
UC06: Warehouse Operator verifies pickup/delivery at designated stations
BR28–31, BR38, BR78, BR85, BR87–89; rule details/numeric retry policy are incomplete
FE07 test scope includes pickup, QR, delivery and mission completion validation

implemented: Assignment atomically snapshots the route, map revision, station QR expectations and optional package code before publishing.
AT_PICKUP waits for Operator QR/manual physical-loading confirmation; only then may navigation to delivery continue.
AT_DELIVERY waits for unloading verification; final robot event is required before task/assignment completion and robot release.
QR mismatches are logged and keep the robot stopped; manual verification requires a reason and explicit physical confirmation.
UUID/request fingerprint makes identical retries idempotent; altered payload under the same ID is rejected.
Serializable transactions, cursor concurrency token, fresh camera/stopped reports, robot health and safety holds guard state transitions.
Mission route/cursor, ordered waypoint arrivals, scan events, attempts, final verification, status history and audit actor/time/state persist to DB.
GET mission list/detail and Operator verification UI show persisted progress, results and history; Admin/Maintenance cannot submit verification.
Recovery reads durable pickup evidence after restart; legacy unknown assignments remain fail-closed.

policyChoices.expectedQr: Stations.QrCodePayload snapshotted at dispatch; ArUco navigation IDs are separate.
policyChoices.package: When a task has PackageCode, QR-mode verification must also match that package code.
policyChoices.manualRole: Warehouse Operator, following UC06; reason and physical-transfer confirmation required.
policyChoices.maxQrAttempts: Verification:MaxQrAttempts, default 3, configurable 1–20; numeric default is an implementation choice, not a number specified by BA.
policyChoices.stationFreshness: Stopped camera report within 15 seconds and received after backend process start.
policyChoices.stationPlacement: Pickup/delivery stops must be outside reserved intersections.

validation.build: Backend 0 errors/0 warnings; TypeScript and Vite build passed. Vite retains a >500 kB chunk-size warning.

migration.historicalData: Preserved; no proof was fabricated for old completed missions. No operational task was created/cancelled/reset for testing.

deployment.webots: Matching driver copied to installed controller and main world reloaded; R01/R02 localized.

limitations: The legacy JetRacer/ROS CIRCLE adapter has not been ported or hardware-tested for this handshake.
Persistence retains evidence; navigation epoch changes/reconnects still stop for Maintenance recovery. Automatic physical resume after restart remains separate work.
Station-to-ArUco commissioning must match the real layout; general warehouse/station CRUD and map-version management remain in the broader backlog.
UI accepts keyboard/USB scanner payloads. No phone-camera scanner or physical load sensor is implemented.
These tests do not mark all 152 planned acceptance cases as passed; broader performance, multi-robot, hardware and soak acceptance remain.
